data.title: 橘美花莉 · 社团教室的摄影指导
data.description: 放学后的漫研教室里，美花莉身穿黑色开襟西装的高中制服站在黑板前，利用自己作为现役人气模特的专业经验，认真向奥村示范如何在不同打光角度下寻找最上镜的身体线条。她抬手轻抚发梢，栗棕长发的两侧束发与粉色缎带轻晃，粉色眼眸中满是渴望被心上人多注视一眼的自信与期待。
data.action: 在黑板前单手叉腰示范模特站姿与受光角度，粉眸含笑凝视镜头
data.promptProse: Inside the after-school manga clubroom, popular teen fashion model Mikari Tachibana demonstrates camera angles in front of the blackboard with professional grace. Her open black uniform blazer with gold buttons sits over a beige sweater vest and white shirt, a red bow tie and short grey pleated skirt completing the outfit as she strikes a practiced pose. Her long chestnut brown hair, gathered into two-side-up bunches with pink ribbons, catches the warm sunset rays streaming through the classroom windows. Her bright pink eyes sparkle with pride and playful charm as she poses directly toward the viewer. Seated-height medium shot capturing her natural charisma.
